answer: In our decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, Sybil resistance is achieved through a stake-slashing matrix that enforces a strict linear relationship between agent participation and capital commitment, thereby preventing any single entity from achieving a nadir of influence. This is further reinforced by a reputation system based on verifiable delay attestations, which creates a ripple effect of distrust among malicious agents, causing them to be relegated to a lower terrace of influence within the network.
